title: Sirrah
html_source: Gifford : Elizabethan address to a person of a lower class.

anchor.prefix:
bts. We have King Lear: and it is immortal. 

 Mr Best's face, appealed to, agreed. 

Flow over them with your waves and with your waters, Mananaan,
Mananaan MacLir... 

 How now,
anchor.suffix:
, that pound he lent you when you were hungry? 

 Marry, I wanted it. 

 Take thou this noble. 

 Go to! You spent most of it in Georgina Johnson's bed, clergyman's daughter. Agenb
